trip.title: Málaga + Tarifa
trip.subtitle: 11 days · May 2026
trip.description: Andalusia road trip: 5 nights Málaga, 3 in Tarifa, 3 back in Málaga. Birthday on day 7.

places.name: Alcazaba
places.description: 11th-c Moorish fortress with gardens and views over the city.
places.notes: Combo €5.50 with Gibralfaro. Go early to avoid heat.

places.name: Castillo de Gibralfaro
places.description: Hilltop castle with the best panoramic views of Málaga.
places.notes: Walk up via Paseo Don Juan de Temboury for the path. Sunset is unbeatable.

places.name: Roman Theatre
places.description: 1st-c BC Roman theatre at the foot of the Alcazaba.

places.name: Catedral La Manquita
places.description: ‘The one-armed lady’ — Renaissance cathedral with rooftop access.
places.notes: Climb rooftop (€10) for 360° views. Closes early on Sundays.

places.name: English Cemetery
places.description: Oldest Protestant cemetery in Spain. Quiet, weirdly beautiful.

places.name: Museo Picasso
places.description: Picasso's hometown collection in a 16th-c palace.

places.name: Centre Pompidou Málaga
places.description: Modern art in an iconic glass cube on the port.

places.name: Museo de Málaga
places.description: Fine arts + archaeology, free for EU citizens.

places.name: CAC Málaga
places.description: Contemporary art center, free, excellent rotating exhibitions.

places.name: La Térmica
places.description: Cultural center in old hospital — exhibitions, talks, free.

places.name: Museo Automovilístico
places.description: Vintage cars and fashion in a former tobacco factory.

places.name: Museo del Vidrio
places.description: Glass museum in 18th-c building, guided visits in EN/ES.

places.name: Museo del Vino Málaga
places.description: Wine history museum with complimentary tasting.

places.name: Calle Larios
places.description: Marble pedestrian shopping street, the city's spine.

places.name: MAUS murals self-tour
places.description: MAUS project murals — Obey, D*Face, ROA, Boa Mistura.

places.name: Lagunillas barrio
places.description: Alt street art neighborhood, gritty, gentrifying. Off-beaten path.

places.name: Pedregalejo paseo
places.description: Old fishing barrio promenade, palms, chiringuitos.

places.name: Muelle Uno port
places.description: Port promenade, sunset spot, glass cube of Pompidou.

places.name: Plaza de la Merced
places.description: Picasso's birthplace square, late-night bars, palm tree obelisk.

places.name: El Pimpi
places.description: Iconic 1971 wine cellar bar; share tapas, touristy but right.

places.name: El Tapeo de Cervantes
places.description: Small, excellent modern tapas. Book ahead.

places.name: La Tranca
places.description: Vermouth + tapas, no-reservation, packed with locals.

places.name: Los Patios de Beatas
places.description: Wine bar with tapas in a converted patio house.

places.name: El Tintero
places.description: Auction-style fish — waiters yell dishes, you grab. Lunch only.

places.name: Antigua Casa de Guardia
places.description: Oldest taberna (1840), wines from the barrel.

places.name: Mercado Atarazanas stalls
places.description: Eat at the bar inside the historic market.

places.name: O Melhor Croissant
places.description: Caramelized sweet croissants with savory fillings (tuna, ham). Unique.

places.name: La Catrina Cervecería
places.description: Best Mexican in Málaga, locals' tip.

places.name: Playa Pedregalejo
places.description: Calmer, palm trees, espetos at chiringuitos.

places.name: Playa de la Caleta
places.description: Quieter middle ground between Malagueta and Pedregalejo.

places.name: Peña Flamenca Juan Breva
places.description: Authentic local flamenco. Reserve via Señor Paco.

places.name: Mercadillo Recinto Ferial
places.description: 300+ stalls — Málaga's biggest Sunday flea. Vintage clothing, vinyl, antiques, plants.
places.notes: Arrive by 10am. Bus 4 from Alameda Principal.

places.name: Cortijo de Torres mercadillo
places.description: 315 stalls Wednesdays — biggest weekly. Clothing, sweets, plants, music CDs.

places.name: El Zoco Muelle Uno
places.description: Curated artisan market on the port, 2nd Sunday.

places.name: Merced Artisan Market
places.description: First Sunday/month — handmade crafts + live music.
places.notes: Skipped — first Sunday is May 3 which is outside trip range.

places.name: Mercadillo El Palo
places.description: Saturday street market by the seaside promenade.

places.name: Mercado Atarazanas
places.description: Iconic 1879 market with Moorish arch. 250 stalls.

places.name: Jardín Botánico La Concepción
places.description: Huge garden, dome viewpoint, cactus garden, tranquil.

places.name: Parque de Málaga
places.description: Tropical palm avenue between centro and port.

places.name: Monte Victoria viewpoint
places.description: Hidden hike for sunset, no crowds.

places.name: Monte San Antón hike
places.description: 500m peak, sea views, behind El Palo.

places.name: Cueva del Tesoro
places.description: One of only 3 marine caves in Europe.

places.name: Skatepark Rubén Alcántara
places.description: Main Málaga skate park, named after pro BMX.

places.name: Caminito del Rey
places.description: Famous suspended walkway above the Guadalhorce canyon.
places.notes: BOOK NOW. 5–10 €. Often sells out 2–4 weeks ahead. Allow full day with transport.

places.name: Ronda
places.description: Famous Puente Nuevo bridge over El Tajo gorge.
places.notes: Train ~2h from Málaga. Bullring, gorge views.

places.name: Nerja + Frigiliana
places.description: Cliffside town with caves, plus white village Frigiliana inland.

places.name: Granada / Alhambra
places.notes: 2h train. Without Alhambra tickets it's still worth visiting Albayzín.

places.name: El Torcal de Antequera
places.description: Surreal karst landscape, alien rock formations.

places.name: Río Chíllar
places.description: River-walk through canyon — you walk IN the water.

places.name: Genalguacil open-air art village
places.description: Open Museum, contemporary art village in the mountains.

places.name: Parauta Enchanted Forest
places.description: Forest with carved tree faces, magical.

places.name: Júzcar Smurf Village
places.description: Houses painted blue, ex-Smurfs movie promo.

places.name: Frigiliana white village
places.description: One of Spain's prettiest pueblos blancos.

places.name: Laguna Fuente de Piedra
places.description: Pink flamingo lake, May = peak season.

places.name: Playa Los Lances
places.description: Main town beach, 10km of sand, kitesurfers everywhere.

places.name: Valdevaqueros + dune
places.notes: Parking €5. Get there early on windy days.

places.name: Playa Bolonia
places.description: Wild beach + giant dune you can climb. Best in the area.

places.name: Punta Paloma clay baths
places.description: Natural clay/mud baths at the cliff base — free spa.

places.name: Playa Chica
places.description: Small sheltered cove, calm water (rare in Tarifa).

places.name: Los Alcornocales Natural Park
places.description: Cork oak forests, hidden waterfalls, network of trails.

places.name: Punta de Tarifa
places.description: Southernmost point of continental Europe — Atlantic meets Mediterranean.

places.name: Murallas del Castillo
places.description: Sea views from the old walls.

places.name: Tarifa old town wander
places.description: Whitewashed alleys, surf shops, Moorish details.

places.name: Mirador de África
places.description: Hidden square behind Guzmán castle, view to Africa.

places.name: Hidden tile-art tunnel
places.description: Tunnel by tourism office with tile illustration + weathervane lamp.

places.name: Baelo Claudia ruins
places.description: 1st-century BC Roman city overlooking the Atlantic.
places.notes: €1.50 EU citizens with passport, €5 otherwise. Don't skip the museum.

places.name: Hike Silla del Papa
places.description: Iberian-Roman ruins on a viewpoint above Bolonia.

places.name: Tangier (Morocco)
places.notes: FRS or Inter Shipping. ~€40 round trip. Passport required.

places.name: Castillo Santa Catalina
places.description: 19th-c fort on cliff (often closed, exterior only).

places.name: Whale & dolphin watching
places.description: Boat trip in the Strait of Gibraltar. ALREADY BOOKED.
places.notes: May 18 — Raluca's birthday. Bring layers, sun cream, seasickness pills if needed.

places.name: Kitesurf taster lesson
places.description: Tarifa is THE European kitesurf spot. Schools: Freeride, Tarifa Max, ION Club.

places.name: SUP / paddleboard
places.description: Calmer days only — rent at Hurricane or surf schools.

places.name: BiBo Beach House
places.description: Dani García's beach concept — Michelin chef, sunset over Atlantic.

places.name: Hurricane Hotel Restaurant
places.description: Elegant beachfront restaurant. Live music, flamenco, romantic.

places.name: Biento
places.description: Rooftop with Los Lances views, paellas, DJ sessions.

places.name: Arte Vida
places.description: Funky garden on the beach, DJs in summer, reasonable prices.

places.name: Las Rejas (Bolonia)
places.description: Fresh fish on the beach at Bolonia, atún rojo specialty.

places.name: El Francés
places.description: Tapas near the port, walkable from whale-watching pier.

places.name: Confitería La Tarifeña
places.description: Old town bakery — birthday cake source.

places.name: Waikiki chiringuito
places.description: Pre-dinner drinks at sunset, view of Morocco.

places.name: Sky Bar Hotel Tarifa Lances
places.description: New panoramic rooftop over Los Lances + Valdevaqueros.

places.name: Bar Ahti
places.description: 2nd-floor sea view, panoramic windows. Best at sunset.
